renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium Stella zodiac-guardian future-promise card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. For newly generated editions show exactly the approved named guardian pair or canonical internal pair, never a third guardian, unseen recipient, human, body clue, shadow, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, relative size/colors, silhouette, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Pair plus focal promise device covers 55–65% and reads at actual width 80px. Build an open, revisable future-promise structure: every map panel, box, page, moon panel, cue arch, plan rail, agreement plane, folio, chart, footboard, blueprint, selector, token, peg, clip, cover, latch or cradle stays removable, half-set, unlatched, open-ended or reorderable. Stella trails begin at each guardian's own chest star, remain visually distinct, and leave through a specified open gap; never merge identities or form a closed destiny ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, cage or predetermined route. Symbols/simple shapes only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, name, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Keep each composition distinct in camera, depth axis, dominant silhouette, open negative-space shape, reversible control and split light path. Only Aries source action-heart1, Aquarius source heart-profile bottles2 and Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip1 are allowed; no other heart or heart-shaped void/light. No deterministic marriage, reunion, return, disclosure, agreement, growth, sacrifice, forgiveness or shared destiny. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. The approved Pisces pilot is an inherited byte-identical exception and must not be regenerated or edited. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor on visible paper texture, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
